caption: The drawing depicts a folded quilt with intricate patterns and floral designs. The quilt primarily consists of a light cream or off-white background with visible quilted stitching forming geometric diamond and square patterns. It features a central wreath-like arrangement composed of six pink-red flowers, each with a yellow center, and multiple green leaves. The quilt's borders are decorated with alternating wide and narrow stripes in shades of red, pink, and brown, with the brown stripes patterned with a subtle design. On the top edge of the quilt, there is a single pink-red flower with green leaves. Below the main image is an inset detail showing a close-up view of one of the pink-red flowers with a yellow center and an adjacent green leaf, placed against the cream quilted background. The drawing includes the name "Catherine Hastings" in small green text.
title: Quilt - Garden Wreath
